Make it zero on a stage that writes no region: hold `spaces` as `Arc<Vec<Space>>` (or a CowVec) and take `Arc::make_mut` at its writers (place.rs:284 and :580, write.rs:716, :879, :945, file.rs:379, :383; readers place.rs:771, premap.rs:671 unchanged).
